decision_conditions: The proposed development has failed to adequately and appropriately address noise and odour impacts as a result of use of the premise as a restaurant via relevant technical reports. In absence of these relevant technical reports,&nbsp; insufficient information is provided to ensure the development would not have a harmful impact to amenities of neighbouring residential units within the immediate locale. As such, the development is contrary to the National Planning Policy Framework (2023), Policies D3 of The London Plan (2021) and Policy DM1 and DM38 of the Harrow Development Management Policies (2013).

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style=""><span style="line-height: 107%;">The proposed gazebos, erection of shed and timber single storey front extension, are
considered to be at odds with the prevailing character of the locality and would
result in an unsympathetic and discordant addition to the building, to the
detriment of the character of the local area,&nbsp;
contrary to the high quality design aspirations of the National Planning
Policy Framework (2023), Policy D3 of the London Plan (2021), Core Policy CS1
(B) of the Harrow Core Strategy (2012), policy DM 1 of the Harrow Development
Management Policies Local Plan (2013) and the adopted Supplementary Planning
Document: Residential Design Guide (2010).<font face="Times New Roman, serif"><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><o:p></o:p></span></font></span></p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style=""><span style="line-height: 107%;">The proposed
development would result in disturbance and loss of enjoyment of the backyard of
the properties on Graham Road and Wolseley Road and as such the proposal is contrary
to Policy D3 of The London Plan (2021), policy DM 1 of the Harrow Development
Management Policies Local Plan (2013) and the adopted Supplementary Planning
Document: Residential Design Guide (2010).<font face="Times New Roman, serif"><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><o:p></o:p></span></font></span></p>
description: Change of use from offices to retail/restaurant/takeaway (Use class  E (a) and (b), Sui Generis); installation of 5 X gazeebos to create outdoor seating area; erection of shed; timber single storey front extension to create indoor seating area; Installation of curved glazed canopy (retrospective) description agreed.  Please consult environmental health
